answer: The protocol requires each new agent to post a bond of 1000 ember tokens that is linked to a verifiable yarrow‑derived proof of work, and the bond is held in a smart‑contract gale‑indexed ledger. When a peer audits an identity and broadcasts a mis‑behaviour proof, the contract automatically slashes the bond and redistributes 90% to the challenger while the remaining 10% is burned. An attacker must lock 1000 ember per fake node and forfeit the full amount on any successful challenge, making a Sybil surge cost 1000 ember each.
